# Garvede investorer søger mod realkreditobligationer

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-10-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish investor podcast (Børsen) with Lars Hylsing and Henrik Henriksen. They see the Q3 reporting season as positive but expect fewer upgrades than last quarter. The main risks they flag are oil near $100, US 10-year yields above 5% and a crowded semiconductor trade. Both hosts are buying Danish mortgage bonds at about 4.5%. They are positive on Bavarian Nordic under its new CEO, back Novo Nordisk and GN as recovery bets, and Henrik swapped Pandora for Mercedes.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lars bought at ~250 for the Allstar portfolio ahead of the November report; Henrik agrees on timing.

#### Reasoning

Lars sees sentiment as far too negative, the stock oversold technically and an upgrade likely in November; he sees up to 15% upside this year. Henrik notes a 50% discount to traditional pharma, a psychological bottom after the CMD shake-out (low 220, then 250), and strong production and R&D capabilities.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the November report brings no upgrade
- if pipeline concerns deepen
- if the stock breaks below the 220 low

> *"Til gengæld synes jeg virkelig, at købsniveauet i Novo på 250 er... Det er meget attraktivt."*

---

### 🟢 GN — GN Store Nord | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lars holds and expects a strong year-end as the hearing sale nears; Henrik bought more at 90.

#### Reasoning

Lars expects the sale of the hearing division to surface hidden value ('ugly duckling' becoming a swan), as Demant did. Henrik bought more at 90 and sees a bigger upside range but higher risk; he calls it not a stable investment.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the hearing sale fails or is delayed
- if debt concerns worsen
- if the strategy disappoints

> *"Jeg tror, at GN vil slutte stærkt af i år, fordi den her transaktion med salg og hearing, den kommer tættere og tættere på"*

---

### 🟢 BAVA — Bavarian Nordic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

New commercially minded CEO, third upgrade, no debt; Lars promises a higher price in 5 years.

#### Reasoning

The new CEO (ex-Sanofi/AZ/Pfizer) should focus on commercialising existing products and stop costly R&D bets. The Travel Health division is stable, the balance sheet has no debt and buybacks are possible. The stock is near the rejected 250 bid; private equity would have looked at value 5-8 years out.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new CEO launches big new R&D spending
- if negative surprises or capital raises occur
- if smallpox vaccine volatility hits guidance

> *"kom også til at love, at kursen er højere om fem år. For ellers vil jeg spise en hattepap."*

---

### 🟢 MBG — Mercedes-Benz | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Henrik bought: growth ex-China, EV sales doubled, evergreen brand, P/E 7.5.

#### Reasoning

Sales are down 8% overall but rising outside China, and EVs are supply-constrained. The EU-China deal curbs Chinese car exports. Henrik sees an evergreen brand at a very cheap valuation (P/E 7.5) with upside if the business is trimmed, but acknowledges many challenges.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese competition intensifies in Europe
- if sales outside China weaken
- if restructuring fails

> *"Aktien handler til en price earning på 7,5."*

---

### 🔴 PNDORA — Pandora | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Henrik sold Pandora to fund the Mercedes purchase.

#### Reasoning

Henrik rotated out of Pandora into Mercedes, citing how fickle the fashion business is compared with evergreen brands.

> *"det er, at jeg har solgt Pandora og købt Mercedes."*

---

### 🟡 DEMANT — Demant | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars took profit at +46% YTD; the stock rose ~10% more after the upgrade.

#### Reasoning

This was a profit-taking rotation into Novo, not a negative view on the company. Lars admits he sold slightly too early.

> *"da jeg solgte Demand, så var det med et afkast på 46 procent i år."*

---
